title: Vendor lock-in: how to avoid getting trapped by your software

points.heading: What vendor lock-in really means
points.body: Lock-in is any situation where the cost of switching suppliers is high enough that you stay put even when you'd rather not.

points.heading: 1. Who owns the code?
points.body: This is the one people get wrong most often.

points.heading: 2. Can you get your data out?
points.body: Your data is yours, but only if you can actually extract it.

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
cta.sub: Who owns your code, your data and your hosting?
